description: Titus's weapon slot: each of Cloud's six swords becomes a Space Marine 2 melee weapon (model read from the player's SM2 copy, combat feel set here). Values are multipliers on Cloud's own numbers so Remake's balance and upgrades still apply.

columns.ff7r_item_id: Equipment table row id of that weapon.
columns.sm2_weapon: SM2 weapon template whose model and sounds are used.
columns.display_name: Name shown in Remake's menus when Titus holds it.
columns.damage_mult: Multiplier on the combo's physical damage.
columns.speed: Combo speed feel: fast / medium / slow.

rows.description: Astartes chainsword. Its teeth chew through armour: hits keep stagger climbing.
rows.special: Held attack revs the blade: continuous damage while the button is held.

rows.description: A disruption field cleaves anything it touches. High damage, quick recovery.
Every blow releases a thunderclap. Slow, crushing, staggers whole crowds.
A gauntlet that hits like a tank shell. Builds stagger fastest.
rows.special: Executions from the fist refill one extra armour plate.

rows.description: A blessed axe that channels the Emperor's will. Spells cast while it is held hit harder.
rows.special: Keeps the Mythril Saber's magic bonus.

rows.description: Fast and vicious. Short combos, quick dodges, fastest Fury gain.
